content.text:
Built a complete playable **Resident Evil 4–inspired village survival game**.

- Three enemy waves
- Blacktail-style pistol with ammo and reload
- Health system, enemies, particles, and game-over state
- Keyboard/mouse controls
- Mobile touch controls
- Responsive village environment

Run it with:

```bash
python3 -m http.server 3002
```
